description: A hike someone likes or wants to do, on Hiker Atlas (https://www.hikeratlas.com).

main.description: One per hike: its record key is derived from the hike's key, so faving it again replaces it.

hike.description: A curated hike, as Hiker Atlas named it when faved. Hikes are rebuilt from OpenStreetMap, so this carries enough to find it again.

key.description: Its key in hikeratlas/routes: park, kind, trailhead, destination and shape.
